points.quote: A document is a Yjs CRDT (`Y.Doc`). BlockSuite blocks live inside it as nested `Y.Map`/`Y.Array`/`Y.Text` structures.
Any update whose origin isn't its own is applied with `Y.applyUpdate(doc, update, NBSTORE_ORIGIN)`. The editor renders from the `Y.Doc`, so it updates automatically.
Storage and the network only handle binary Yjs updates (`Uint8Array`).
Blobs (images and attachments) and awareness (presence) are stored and synced separately from doc content.
Browser: `impls/idb`, an IndexedDB store. Desktop and mobile: `impls/sqlite`, a native SQLite file per workspace
A sync peer connects the local storage to each remote storage. ... Cloud workspaces use `impls/cloud/doc.ts`, a socket.io client.
